metadata_selection: earliest64 per window by(raw_ns,ordinal); PCAP file order and timestamps unchanged
causal_validity: TCP and completed TLS record time monotonic within each direction; genuine gaps/conflicts/malformed/censor remain invalid
cross_direction_packet_order: diagnostic only; never proof of stream-causal error
ambiguity: equal raw completion timestamp across directions
mask_application: delete inadmissible scores before any group/flow calibration or decision; raw scores diagnostic only
physical_claim: capture-time adjacency is not plaintext request/reply causality; observed skew is not a clock-error bound
